title: Treatment and management of Hoof Diseases & Hardware Disease
text:
Foot rot
Inter-digital dermatitis

Treatment and management:
- Foot care management
- Medicated foot bath

7. HARDWARE DISEASE (Bovine traumatic reticulopericarditis) – ingestion of sharp or foreign objects resulting to irritation and penetration in the lining of the reticulum.

facts: Foot rot and inter-digital dermatitis are bovine foot diseases shown on the page.
Treatment and management for foot conditions include foot care management.
Treatment and management for foot conditions include the use of a medicated foot bath.
Hardware Disease is clinically referred to as Bovine traumatic reticulopericarditis.
Hardware disease is caused by the ingestion of sharp or foreign objects.
Ingestion of sharp or foreign objects in hardware disease results in irritation and penetration in the lining of the reticulum.

questions.question: What is the scientific or clinical veterinary term for 'Hardware Disease'?

options.A: Bacterial infection of the interdigital cleft
options.B: Ingestion of sharp or foreign objects
options.C: Severe deficiency of calcium and phosphorus
options.D: Excessive accumulation of gas in the rumen

questions.question: In hardware disease, foreign objects irritate and penetrate the lining of which digestive compartment?

options.A: Foot care management and medicated foot bath
options.C: Oral magnetic bolus and calcium gluconate
options.D: Pasture burning and complete herd isolation

questions.question: Which statement regarding hardware disease is TRUE?

options.A: Hardware disease is caused by ingestion of sharp foreign objects penetrating the lining of the reticulum.

options.C: Hardware disease is treated by walking cows through a medicated foot bath.
options.D: Hardware disease refers exclusively to digital dermatitis of the lower limbs.
